title: Why High Applicant Numbers SHOULDN'T Stop You From Applying 🔎
description:
Job postings with high applicant numbers are always discouraging to see, but they don’t have to be. Two reasons why you should still apply even when you see those numbers are…

1) The applicant numbers on LinkedIn are CLICKS to the application, not necessarily the number of people who have applied.

2) Not everyone who will apply is qualified

Bonus tip: Apply on the company site for the best chance to be seen. #linkedin #linkedintips #jobapplication #jobapplicationtips
